label: Session N
policy: Tier A = government, regulator, court, or statutorily official publisher. Tier B = SEC filing by the subject company or its industry benchmark. Tier C = official non-government producer of regional statistics (LAEDC). Every source below was opened and read on the access date by this session; no value was copied from another session's work product.
